toolsPreview.name: validate_translation
toolsPreview.description: Validate a translation with nabanya, the Connection Validator: it confirms your words transmit their feelings in the reader's language. It never rewrites your words. This is a PAID reading (N1 $15, N2 $10, N3 $5, N4 $3): the reply gives you the payment link and your report link. When the payment clears, the reading is prepared and sent to your report link and email.
